title: CFU/g

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

explanation: Extends the CFU/mL formula to solid or semi-solid samples by folding in the initial homogenization step (e.g. blending a solid sample into a diluent) as its own dilution factor, in addition to any further serial dilution before plating.

variables.meaning: Number of colonies counted on the plate
mass / (mass + diluent volume) — the dilution introduced by initial sample preparation
Any additional serial dilution factor applied after homogenization

workedExample.scenario: 25 colonies from 0.1 mL plated, where 10 g of sample was homogenized into 90 mL diluent (Dhomogenization = 10/100 = 0.1) with no further dilution (Dplate = 1).

commonMistakes: Treating the homogenization step as if it introduces no dilution, which significantly underestimates the true CFU/g.
